title: Independent compact-context response-control implementation and maintenance study
description: A frozen 96-session comparison of four unseen authenticated, validated, conflict-aware, or creation-oriented server-plus-browser assignments in Parley, Python, TypeScript, and Rust, using the pre-corpus 124-token Parley response-web card.

validated_transport.channel: Two protected mode-0600 POSIX FIFOs carry bounded request and public-feedback messages; only the parent evaluator binds loopback.
validated_transport.threat_boundary: The transport is a measurement-integrity mechanism for command-constrained agents, not an isolation boundary against a deliberately hostile workspace process.

validated_exact_build_freeze.positive_control: Canonical manifest/lock survives native release and wasm32 release builds byte-for-byte.
validated_exact_build_freeze.negative_control: A displaced root block passes cargo metadata --locked --offline; cargo build --release returns zero and rewrites it; post-command hashes reject the build.
validated_exact_build_freeze.required_integration: Reference validation and measured evaluation must hash every protected/read-only input immediately after each exact build command for every language, in addition to final workspace integrity.

scratch_space_control.preflight_timing: Resolve disjoint work, journal, and attempt roots and require the full four-worker budget before journal initialization or any measured cell start.
scratch_space_control.evidence_boundary: The disposable work root and durable journal/attempt roots must be distinct real directories with no equal, ancestor, or descendant relationship.
scratch_space_control.cleanup_order: Persist the complete finished journal and external parent attempts before removing that journal's exact real immediate-child workspace through cleanup_finished_workspace.
scratch_space_control.resume_policy: On resume, seal every started unfinished cell as a permanent failure before reclaiming only workspaces certified by finished records; run only never-started cells.
scratch_space_control.failure_policy: Preflight, boundary, cleanup, or renewed capacity failure stops scheduling new cells, remains an execution-integrity failure after any cell starts, and never authorizes a rerun.
scratch_space_control.calibration_rule: Clean-room harness validation must measure peak per-cell scratch use. Revision 2 may increase, but never lower, the frozen reserve or per-worker budget before the first measured session.

matrix.derivation: 4 tasks x 4 languages x 2 agent configurations x 3 replicates

parley.stack: Generated native HTTP/JSON server with checked dynamic response envelopes, dependency-free strict route codecs, and generated browser WebAssembly bindings
parley.agent_context: Frozen 124-token v0.5.6 compact response-web card used alone and included in measured input tokens; canonical compact manifests are capped at 135 tokens.

python.stack: FastAPI 0.141.1, Uvicorn 0.52.1, Pydantic 2.13.4, and a counted browser JavaScript application module

rust.stack: Axum 0.8.9, Tokio 1.53.1, Tower HTTP 0.7.0, Serde 1.0.229, serde_json 1.0.151, and a scalar WebAssembly export

scaffold_protocol.purpose: Supply stable language-appropriate transport, build, and browser wiring so the measured assignment is application implementation or repair rather than framework installation.
scaffold_protocol.editable: All task-specific application logic, typed request/body/response envelope declarations, authorization/validation/conflict handlers, browser rule modules, and application manifests required by that language.
scaffold_protocol.read_only: Dependency locks, generic launch adapters, shared static shell, frozen contract, source printer, generated check client, public check wrapper, and benchmark configuration.
scaffold_protocol.source_visibility: The first shell command prints every editable and visibly read-only source/context file exactly once. Direct reconnaissance or reading protected case/configuration files is forbidden.
scaffold_protocol.dependency_setup: Pinned dependencies are installed or fetched before measured sessions. Each parent evaluation uses only the frozen local dependency store; network time is never part of a cell.
scaffold_protocol.reference_validation: Before any agent session, an isolated reference application for every task/language must run the exact measured build commands under post-command hash checks, preserve all protected/read-only inputs, and pass every public and hidden HTTP status/JSON/custom-header plus browser case. Seeded maintenance applications must build with stable hashes, fail their public response-control case, and pass after changing only the predeclared route-handler root file.
scaffold_protocol.rust_lockfile: Generate Cargo.lock canonically from the final fullstack-agent-046 manifest. Run cargo build --locked --offline --release and the exact wasm32 release build under immediate post-command hash checks before execution freeze, and preserve that reviewed hash in every measured workspace.
scaffold_protocol.symmetry: Every language receives the same English contract and semantic cases. Framework-specific source and configuration may differ, but no language receives a hidden expected value or repair.

session_protocol.runner: A new iteration-046 runner creates one isolated workspace, one external attempt directory, one immutable journal entry, and one ephemeral Codex thread per cell; it must not modify historical runners.
session_protocol.tool_policy: Disable user configuration, repository rules, plugins, apps, browser-use, computer-use, and multi-agent delegation. Use workspace-write with approval never and network disabled.
session_protocol.command_policy: The first shell command must be exactly ./sources and occur once. Every later shell command must be exactly ./check. At least one and at most twelve ./check commands are permitted.
session_protocol.public_feedback: Each ./check request is evaluated by the parent outside the sandbox. It records build output and exact public HTTP status/JSON/custom-header plus real-Chromium verdicts, then returns only bounded public feedback.
session_protocol.public_execution_requirement: Every completed public attempt must actually execute all four public cases, including the declared browser case. A build failure may short-circuit cases but remains a recorded failed attempt; zero semantic case execution cannot count as a passing check.
session_protocol.hidden_judgment: After the agent exits, the parent separately rebuilds final source and executes all withheld HTTP status/JSON/custom-header and browser cases. Hidden inputs and values never enter the workspace or public transport.
session_protocol.attempt_capture: Preserve every parent-owned public attempt, source snapshot, file hash, changed-file list, command event, agent message, diagnostic, stdout/stderr, elapsed time, thread ID, and reported token count.
session_protocol.integrity: Hash all protected/read-only files immediately after every exact build and at cell finalization; reject unexpected files and symlinks; compare FIFO device/inode/type/mode/owner; revalidate frozen repository and toolchain provenance; require one start/finish journal record per cell; preserve the initial and renewed scratch checks without binding observed free bytes into resume identity; persist evidence and measured workspace bytes before bounded per-cell cleanup.
session_protocol.resume_policy: A started cell without a finished record becomes a permanent interruption failure; only never-started cells may execute.
session_protocol.failure_policy: Timeouts, interruptions, agent errors, nonzero exits, build failures, case failures, protocol violations, checker/FIFO/read-only integrity failures, missing source, unexpected files, scratch-boundary violations, low-space events after start, and cleanup failures are failures and remain in the complete result.
session_protocol.domain_judgment: The parent validates JSON syntax and declared JSON types but does not pre-reject negative integers or zero-capacity combinations. Those typed values must reach every language handler and receive the frozen 422 envelope.

execution_freeze.description: Validated compact-context response-control harness, JSON-native evidence boundary, transparent proxy, scratch lifecycle, and exact-build inputs frozen before the first measured cell; semantic and gate inputs are unchanged.
execution_freeze.public_attempt_storage: JSON-native atomic files outside the workspace, reread during cell finalization and result aggregation.
execution_freeze.scratch_preflight: 17,179,869,184 bytes free required before journal initialization and each scheduling refill, with work/journal/attempt roots proven disjoint.
execution_freeze.workspace_cleanup: Write a separate immutable cleanup record after the complete finished journal; retain pre-cleanup bytes and removal, absence, or failure status.
execution_freeze.bounded_scheduler: At most four cells active; capacity or cleanup failure stops refills and permanently journals every unstarted cell as failed without an agent session.
execution_freeze.response_proxy: Identical transparent parent-owned loopback proxy for every language; typed negative and zero-domain values reach the application handler.
execution_freeze.application_header_judgment: Compare the complete normalized multiset of JSON-native non-server, non-hop-by-hop response-header pairs; missing, extra, wrong, or duplicate application headers fail.
execution_freeze.exact_build_integrity: Check every protected/read-only file before and immediately after each exact build command; any mutation fails the build and cell.
execution_freeze.resume_policy: A started cell without a finished record becomes a permanent interruption failure; only never-started cells may execute.

metrics.correctness: Exact hidden HTTP status/JSON/error/custom application headers and real-browser scalar results, overall and by task, kind, language, model, and replicate.
metrics.first_check: Whether the first parent-owned public build and all four public cases pass, with HTTP and browser execution counts retained.
metrics.repairs: Number of later ./check attempts after the first, with every parent attempt retained outside the workspace.
metrics.tokens: Complete reported Codex input, cached input, uncached input, output, reasoning output, and input-plus-output totals. Primary efficiency uses complete input-plus-output tokens per assignment.
metrics.elapsed: Monotonic wall time for the whole fresh session, including parent-owned public builds and repairs but excluding dependency installation.
metrics.maintainability: Changed editable files, rough token edit size, and whether maintenance patches touch exactly the predeclared defect-root file set.
metrics.source: Final and seed UTF-8 bytes, physical lines, rough tokens, o200k_base tokens, and per-file SHA-256, reported descriptively rather than substituted for session tokens.
metrics.cross_target: Authorized/domain-valid HTTP/browser equality for the shared scalar plus successful Chromium execution; status/header branches remain separately exact.

primary_gate.execution_integrity: A preregistered scratch preflight must pass before journaling; all 96 cells must finish exactly once with unique thread IDs, exactly one journal start/finish, durable evidence before bounded workspace cleanup, intact repository/toolchain/checker/read-only/FIFO state including post-build hashes, compliant commands, required public HTTP/browser execution, no runner or cleanup error, and no selective rerun or exclusion.
primary_gate.correctness: Parley must pass 100% of hidden HTTP status/JSON/custom-header and browser cases, and its assignment success rate must be no lower than every baseline overall, within each agent configuration, and within implementation and maintenance tasks.
primary_gate.first_check: Parley's first-public-check assignment success rate must be no lower than the highest baseline rate overall and within each task kind.
primary_gate.tokens: Parley's median complete input-plus-output tokens per assignment must be no higher than the lowest baseline median overall and separately within each agent configuration.
primary_gate.elapsed: Parley's median elapsed seconds per assignment must be no higher than the lowest baseline median overall and separately within each agent configuration.
primary_gate.maintainability: Every hidden-correct Parley maintenance assignment must change exactly its predeclared root file set, and its exact-root rate must be no lower than every baseline.
primary_gate.verdict: All six conditions must hold for strict unseen full-stack agent parity/efficiency. Report every condition independently even when the overall gate fails.

secondary_analysis: Report full distributions, paired task/configuration/replicate cells, and per-task outcomes; do not replace the primary result with successful, repair-free, or model-selected subsets.
Report implementation and maintenance separately, including root-file quality, public/hidden HTTP-browser execution, and disagreement classes.
Report both model configurations separately before any pooled interpretation.
Report public-attempt counts and public case executions so a build-only or browser-skipped check cannot be mistaken for semantic feedback.
Report post-build protected/read-only hash checks by language and build phase; do not collapse them into only the final workspace flag.
Report scratch preflight, peak per-cell/worker usage, each evidence-gated cleanup, and final free space; never delete durable evidence to improve a result.
Compare studies 036–045 only as motivation and mechanism history. Do not combine their task results, tokens, or timing with 046; iteration 045 remains invalid.
Report the frozen context and manifest token counts and prompt delta by language, but do not attribute complete-session token or elapsed differences to context alone.
Classify failures after preserving the frozen outcome; classification cannot change a verdict.
interpretation_boundary: The study covers four small synthetic response-control plus browser contracts, two model IDs, one reasoning setting, and one frozen toolchain environment.
Stack scaffolds test application work, not framework discovery, dependency selection, deployment, sustained load, databases, accessibility, or production operations.
Bearer/API-key comparisons test typed authorization decisions and headers, not identity-provider, credential-storage, cryptographic, session, or policy-system security.
Framework source and compiler implementations are infrastructure. The compact application-facing card and manifests are counted, while complete session tokens remain primary cost.
A deterministic scalar ES-module export in real Chromium is a cross-target check, not a general user-interface evaluation.
Synthetic route-handler defects measure only the declared boundary behaviors and do not estimate production-defect distributions.
Even a fully passing gate cannot prove universal language superiority; it supports only the frozen comparative claim.
A failed strict gate remains useful evidence and cannot be repaired by same-corpus language, context, prompt, task, runner, threshold, or metric tuning.
implementation_rule: The corpus and cross-language scaffold generators were independently frozen before revision 1. Dependency preparation, clean-room validation, orchestration evidence, and every transitive execution hash must be committed in revision 2 before measurement.
change_rule: Task semantics have been immutable since corpus commit 2d3430787917d872b32e3e7c0a43c6882c071e72. From this revision-1 protocol onward, no context, metric, threshold, model, reasoning setting, replicate count, or primary gate may change based on validation, smoke checks, or measured output. An objective harness defect may be corrected only before measurement in a documented zero-session amendment preserving old commits and semantic hashes. Scratch budgets may increase but not decrease.
stop_rule: Run every frozen cell once, preserve and publish the complete result whether positive, mixed, negative, or invalid, and make no same-corpus optimization or rerun. Any later product change requires a corpus outside iteration 046.
